rules.sentence: Suspicion of a general syphilis infection should be confirmed before or considered in conjunction with the diagnosis of neurosyphilis.

Generally, a positive treponemal and nontreponemal test is required for a serological diagnosis of syphilis, but nontreponemal tests tend to normalize over time and may be negative in late neurosyphilis.[29]
